items.name: last30days-skill
items.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary

items.name: vox-director
items.description: Turn one topic into a finished Vox-style paper-collage explainer/ad video — automated end to end on Atlas Cloud + ffmpeg. An agent skill.

items.name: procedural-film
items.description: Agent skill: turn a topic into a 30s vertical film drawn and scored entirely in JavaScript. Reference film: the life of a monarch butterfly.

items.name: vox-ai-motion-graphics-generator
items.description: 🎬 Turn any topic into a finished Vox-style paper-collage explainer / motion graphics video — script, collage keyframes, animation, voice-over, music & captions, all automated. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex & other coding agents.

items.name: ai4s-skills
items.description: Open-source agent skills for AI for Science: topic exploration, literature survey, experiments, paper writing, and integrity audit — driven by any coding agent.

items.name: PaperClaw
items.description: an OpenClaw skill that can generate paper search-review-critque expert-agent relevant to specific topics (we use Scientific ML and 3D geometry surrogate modeling as a demo).

items.name: philosopher-OKF
items.description: Agent skill that turns any topic into one self-contained HTML study page: minimal, light focused, research-paper styled.

items.name: DocMeld
items.description: Lightweight Doc-to-agent-ready knowledge pipeline. Three-stage Bronze→Silver→Gold architecture extracts structured elements, page content, and   AI-enriched metadata from research papers and books. Generate PRDs, workflows, topic clusters, and Claude Code skills from PDFs. No OCR required.

items.name: read-buddy
items.description: Read Buddy: Agent Skills for reading webpages, RSS, YouTube, X, Feishu docs, OCR, podcasts, topics and personal knowledge sources

items.name: zack-d-films-ai-video-generator
items.description: 🎬 Turn any topic into a finished Zack D Films-style 3D animated short — curiosity-loop script, character sheets, 3D keyframes, Veo 3.1 motion, voiceover, captions & punchy edits, all automated. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex & other coding agents. Powered by MuAPI + ffmpeg.

items.description: The Studio. Claude-driven investigation production engine. 10 specialised agents, 62 skills, 8 viewer templates — turn a topic into a publishable, evidence-anchored investigation. Local-first, MIT, bring your own LLM.

items.name: agent-memory-skill
items.description: A portable memory skill and CLI for AI agents: curated context, user preferences, topic interruptions, handoff packets, and model/runtime migration without transcript dumps.

items.name: roadmap-tutor
items.description: Hermes Agent skill: learn any roadmap.sh roadmap one topic at a time, tracked across sessions. Stdlib-only Python, runs on a Raspberry Pi.

items.name: html2video-for-mcode
items.description: Agent skill: turn a topic, outline, or script into a narrated MP4 (HTML slides + staged animations + TTS voiceover + subtitles + ASR verification). Works with MiniMax Code connectors or mmx-cli.

items.name: seonib-skill
items.description: Install one Skill, and your AI coding agent becomes an autonomous SEO content operator that can discover topics, understand your brand, generate SEO/AEO articles, and publish them automatically.

items.name: askaipods
items.description: Search AI podcast key points by topic — find what Lex Fridman, Dwarkesh Patel, No Priors, and Latent Space guests are actually saying. Universal agentskills.io skill compatible with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and any other agent that supports the open skill standard. Powered by podlens.net.

items.name: paper-repo-builder
items.description: Claude skill: turn a research topic into a curated, downloaded, verified, README-indexed paper repository — parallel search agents, browser-login PDF downloads (ACM/IEEE/Springer), metadata verification, optional Zotero sync.

items.name: malt-skills
items.description: 由 MaltSci（麦伴科研）维护的开源科研 Agent Skills 集合，面向课题探索、文献理解、写作交付和科研作图等科研全流程环节。An open-source collection of research Agent Skills maintained by MaltSci, covering the full research workflow from topic exploration and literature understanding to writing, delivery, and scientific figure creation.
